spans.s: ṛjuka, adj. (also ujjuka; = Pali ujuka, ujjuka; Skt. ṛju plus ka), straight, right: SP 〔324.2〕 (but see s.v. ujjuka); KP 〔8.1〕 (prose) ṛjukasya bodhisattvasya ṛjukalakṣaṇāni; Śikṣ 〔285.9〕 (prose) (āśayo …) ṛjukaḥ akutilatvāt; MSV 〔i.47.4〕; adv. ˚kena, straight out, straightforwardly, honestly (before a daśavarga of monks), Śikṣ 〔169.1〕 (prose) āpattir daśavarge ṛjukena deśayitavyā; adv. ṛjukam, id., Bbh 〔6.17〕 (prose) arthikeṣu ca sattveṣu ṛjukaṃ pratipadyate, na māyāśāṭhyenainān vilobhayati; abstr. ˚ka-tā, Gv 〔186.8〕 (prose) mārgakuṭilatāṃ mārgarjukatām anuvilokya (here literally, straightness).
ṛjubhāva, m. (= Pali uju˚), uprightness: Mv 〔ii.97.10〕 ˚vena.

ṛjju, adj. (also ujju; for ṛju, 〔§ 2.82〕; Pali ujju beside uju; AMg. app. only ujju), straight, right, honest: Mv 〔ii.63.15〕, read asaṭh' (or asaḍh'? mss. asadh') ṛjjubhūto (with one ms.); in 〔ii.80.13〕 mss. ṛjubhūtaḥ or ṛjū˚, meter demands ṛjju˚.
